correctStatements.text: At 05:50 Dolores relayed from the night shift lead that pick lists were showing items already shipped.
At 05:56 Ivar reproduced the problem on a test scanner after toggling airplane mode.
Ivar found the sync merge keeps the local list when its timestamp is newer, even if the server marked lines as shipped.
Malin reported three pickers walked to wrong aisles, losing around 40 minutes in total.
At 06:12 Chidi decided to force a full resync on every scanner at next login.
At 06:25 Chidi flipped the server flag, forcing a resync for all 85 devices.
At 06:48 Malin confirmed the floor saw correct lists on the first 60 scanners.
At 07:15 Malin reported all 85 scanners synced with no further bad lists.
Ivar will make the server shipped status take precedence in the sync merge.
Chidi will add an offline mode scenario to the release test checklist.
Dolores recapped that a sync merge bug let stale offline pick lists override shipped status, wasting about 40 picker minutes.
